title: Shared definitions of the role output schemas
description: Not an output schema itself: the others refer to its $defs. Every object lists all its properties as required and forbids others, so the schemas also work with runtimes that enforce strict structured output.

criterion_id.description: Acceptance criterion ID from the spec, e.g. AC-3.

assumption.description: Something taken as true without confirmation. Forecrew registers it as A-n (docs/contracts/data-model.md, assumptions); docs/contracts/council-brief.schema.json repeats this definition.

statement.description: What you take as true, as one sentence.

confidence.description: How sure you are the assumption holds.

impact.description: How much the result changes if the assumption is wrong.

verify_by.description: How it can be checked: a test, a question to a human, or research.

assumptions.description: Every assumption you made; an empty list only if you made none.

escalation.description: Set when you stopped because of an escalation condition: what a human must decide or provide. null otherwise.
